description: Read this project's local session log (read-only; reading does not add to it). Records commands, redacted secrets and inputs, exit codes, durations, URLs, titles, summaries, errors, and output files. Formats: 'table' (default compact table), 'md' (Markdown report of visits, actions, errors, files), or 'json' (raw JSON lines). Covers today unless 'days' is specified. Call it when a browser task is finished to report what was done.

days.description: Include the last N days (1 = today).

name: browser_log
